instruction: The italicized terms are not clear enough. Please change the font size of all italic text to 18 points to make them more readable.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing italic text size to 18pt. Verified document has 21 italic runs at size 12pt (152400 twips). Evaluator checks if all italic text is now size 18.

llm_judge_reasons: Core verification logic is correct: getter retrieves DOCX file, metric checks all italic text in paragraphs for size 18pt
Instruction coverage is complete for typical document structure: checks all italic runs and verifies size matches target
Postconfig appropriately saves file (Ctrl+S) before file extraction, ensuring changes are persisted
Expected value (target_size: 18) correctly matches instruction requirement
Minor semantic limitation: metric only checks italic text in doc.paragraphs (body paragraphs), does not check tables, headers, footers, or text boxes where italic text could exist
For typical documents with italic text in body paragraphs (which appears to be the case based on metadata mentioning 21 italic runs), the evaluator will work correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider extending metric to check italic text in tables: iterate through doc.tables and check cells
Consider checking headers/footers: iterate through doc.sections and check header/footer paragraphs
However, given the task context and metadata, current implementation is likely sufficient for this specific document
